name: Banbury Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Tuesdays and Fridays.

name: Banbury Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Easington Park with 25 plots
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and runs kids gardening clubs.

name: Banbury Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at Castle Quay reducing food waste
description: Located at Castle Quay Shopping Centre
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food. Open during centre hours.
